messages:
From: Jenna Park <events@summitworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Angled banner variance + staggered crate pickup for CloudCon booth

Hi all —

Thanks again for confirming Booth G12. Two quick operations items we need to lock down this week so we can finalize the floorplan and produce permits:

1) Signage variance request — you submitted an "angled banner" that extends 6" into the aisle at 72" height. Per hall rules that typically needs sign-off from show management. I attached the latest floorplan (floorplan_v2.pdf) with the banner callout. Can you confirm final dimensions and whether you want the banner hung from the back wall or mounted on a free-standing pole?

2) Loading dock constraints — the north dock has back-to-back windows that day. We can offer staggered pickup windows (two-slot solution) but need to confirm crate count and whether any crates are oversize (over 48"). FastCrate will need the manifest by Friday to guarantee same-day return.

Attachments: floorplan_v2.pdf (annotated layout)

If you can reply with preferred banner mounting approach and crate sizes by EOD Thur (11/5) that gives us time to push the variance to facilities.

Best,
Jenna Park
Senior Events Manager | SummitWorks
events@summitworks.com
---
SummitWorks — Conference & Exhibition Services

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Angled banner variance + staggered crate pickup for CloudCon booth

Thanks, Jenna —

Quick answers below and a couple of asks so we can move forward: 

- Banner: we prefer a free-stand pole-mounted angled banner (no overhead rigging). Final footprint will be 30" wide x 72" tall and will extend 6" into the aisle as noted. We can reduce the extension to 3" if that helps the variance but would rather keep 6" for sightline to the demo pedestal.
- Mounting: pole base will be weighted; we will supply fireproofing certs if needed.
- Crates: 4 crates total, one is oversize at 52" x 40" x 48" (crate #3).

Actions: 
- Marissa — can you confirm if the marketing team can accept the 3" compromise if facilities push back? We may be able to tweak layout at the demo pedestal to compensate.
- Logan — I'll need a pick-up window proposal from FastCrate that avoids our peak demo setup time (10:00–13:00). Can you coordinate and share estimated lift times?

Also Jenna, please share FastCrate contact who will handle the manifest. Copying in the vendor ops team if that helps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

We can deliver to FastCrate for crate stuffing but need the final artwork no later than EOD 11/5.

Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 07:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Angled banner variance + staggered crate pickup for CloudCon booth

Hi Kimberly / Jenna / Logan —

Thanks for the heads-up. We reviewed the dock windows and your crate dimensions. Proposed pickup windows (both windows are one hour each):

• Window A: 07:00–08:00 (fast load for crates 1 & 2)
• Window B: 14:00–15:00 (oversize crate #3 and crate #4)

Estimated lift time per crate: 12–18 minutes (oversize adds ~8 minutes). We can guarantee return-to-booth same day if the manifest is received by EOD 11/5 and all crates are palletized.

Crate manifest attached (crate_manifest.xlsx) — please confirm weights. Oversize crate #3 flagged "special handling".

If Kimberly prefers to avoid any setup hours, we can shift Window B to 16:00–17:00; however that will push our departure to after the close of show access window and may incur after-hours fees.

Best,
FastCrate Ops Team

All — thank you, this helps a lot.

Decisions / approvals: 
• Signage variance: Approved for the free-stand pole-mounted angled banner at 30" x 72" with a 6" extension. SummitWorks, please push the variance forward; we will provide the fireproofing certificate once AlphaPrints confirms the material spec.
• Crate pickup: Accepting FastCrate Window A (07:00–08:00) for crates 1 & 2 and Window B (14:00–15:00) for oversize crate #3 and crate #4. Logan, please confirm staffing for the 14:00 handoff (we need two people at the pit).
• AlphaPrints: Please proceed with production on 30" x 72" and use the 3.5" flange base. Final artwork attached via Google Drive link below; deliver to FastCrate.

Attachments confirmed: banner_mockup_v3.png, crate_manifest.xlsx, floorplan_v2.pdf
